not decidable by this kit: no kit point runs a VI line shorter than a refresh. What would decide it: a kit point that programs H_SYNC below the 52 rclk refresh holdoff with the VI active and counts the holdoffs per line, as refresh-all-banks counts them per bank

not decidable by this kit: no kit point programs a VI line shorter than its H_VIDEO window, the only VI that reaches the keep-fetching rule. What would decide it: a kit point that programs H_SYNC below the line's fetch time with the VI active and counts the bursts each line fetches through CPU load latency, or a video capture that shows which line the next output line displays. MM never reaches it (cited inputs, inferred conclusion; no run counted overruns): every MM VI mode keeps the NTSC H_SYNC 3093 quarter-px (773 px) against H_VIDEO 108-748 (640 px) (decomp mm-decomp-60fps 56fa21dd0: src/libultra/vimodes/vimodentsclan1.c:14,16; the Bomber's Notebook mode src/code/z_vimode.c:125,146,157), and its 3-line fetch takes about 285-398 of the 3972 rclk line (docs/research/vi-fetch.md, MM bus-occupancy estimate)

not decidable by this kit: the CPU cannot read the VI's output and the sampled value has no bus-timing signature, so no kit ROM measures it and ingestion reads no video. What would decide it: a video capture of the VI output for a mode that samples past the three fetched lines (a Y_SCALE above one line per output row, or an X_SCALE past the line). MM never reaches it (cited inputs, inferred conclusion; no run counted unfetched samples): NTSC LAN1 runs Y_SCALE 1.0 and X_SCALE 0.5 over a 320-px line (decomp mm-decomp-60fps 56fa21dd0: src/boot/idle.c:107, src/libultra/vimodes/vimodentsclan1.c:11,17,24); the Bomber's Notebook hi-res mode sets Y_SCALE 2.0 but interlaced (src/code/z_vimode.c:81-84, src/code/sys_cfb.c:95), where VI::compose draws one row per output line from the line its fetch began at
